items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: is there a piano player named Kenneth Spencer? No, Kenny Spencer was a singer. What's this boy's name used to play with Red Allen?

ctx.x: But in New York City guys wondered for years how I was making it, and I had a very simple pattern. I went to the World Series, I went to the fights, you know, I played the Café Society Downtown with Art Tatum, Lena Horne, Henry Red Allen, Jay C. Higgenbotham, Doc Cheatham and J. C. Heard and ....firma la porte moi!.......Open the window!.....
Eddie Heywood and Art, of course, Teddy Wilson...is there a piano player named Kenneth Spencer? No, Kenny Spencer was a singer. What's this boy's name used to play with Red Allen?
